findings.detail: The maturity_not_past rule fires on current SOI rows whose printed maturity dates are before 2026-03-31, but the source itself reports those dates for still-held positions.

rationale: False alarm: the raw March 31, 2026 schedule of investments prints past maturity dates for current holdings, including One GI LLC at 12/22/25 and MPI Engineered Technologies, LLC at 11/17/25. Because the source supports the extracted past-maturity values, the defect is the rule's scope rather than a data extraction error.
